newsitem.title: ITALY: Rome stages rock concert ahead of food summit.
newsitem.headline: Rome stages rock concert ahead of food summit.

text.p: Rome's ancient Colosseum provided the backdrop on Sunday to an international arts concert launching next month's U.N. World Food Summit.
More than 100 artists from around the world were due to perform during the four-hour event sponsored by the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO).
The concert was organised to draw public attention to the problem of world hunger ahead of the U.N. World Food Summit to be held at FAO's Rome headquarters November 13-17.

Among the performers were New York rock group Fun Lovin' Criminals, Italian pop singer Claudio Baglioni, the Afro-Celt Sound System from Senegal and Ireland, a Chinese dance troupe and a percussion ensemble from Zaire.
Roads around the Colosseum were blocked off as thousands of fans poured into the heart of Rome to watch the multi-cultural concert.
